tasks.title: Single state root and ledger schema
tasks.body:
- **In** nothing
- **Do** create `state/` tree; four stores (`prospects.db`, `outreach.db`, `walker/`, `tasks/`) with explicit schemas
- **Out** migrations that run idempotently on every boot
- **Test** run boot twice → no duplicate tables, no data loss, `state/` tree matches the documented layout

tasks.title: Credential gate that refuses instead of degrading
tasks.body:
- **In** `~/.hermes/.env`
- **Do** read every credential the run needs before it starts; if any is missing, name the variable and stop that channel
- **Out** per-channel readiness map in the run header
- **Test** unset `GMAIL_ADDRESS` → email channel reports `blocked: GMAIL_ADDRESS`, form channel still runs

tasks.title: Zero-spend guard
tasks.body:
- **In** every outbound call
- **Do** refuse any external call with a price tag; maintain an allowlist of free endpoints
- **Out** `state/reports/spend.json` = 0.00 always
- **Test** inject a paid API base URL → call is rejected before the request leaves the box

tasks.title: Single-flight lock per target
tasks.body:
- **In** target id
- **Do** acquire lock before any outbound; release on completion; expire stale locks after 6h
- **Out** lock table
- **Test** two concurrent cycles → exactly one send per target, second exits `already_in_flight`

tasks.title: Idempotency key on every external action
tasks.body:
- **In** (target, channel, artifact hash)
- **Do** derive a key; refuse a second send of the same key within 30 days
- **Out** `outreach.db.sends.key` unique index
- **Test** re-run the staging batch → 0 new sends, N skipped as duplicates

tasks.title: Provenance stamping
tasks.body:
- **In** every parsed fact
- **Do** attach `{value, source, confidence, stamp}` with stamp ∈ `verified | inferred | assumed`
- **Out** provenance-bearing JSON for all deal fields
- **Test** any spec containing an `assumed` money field is refused by the LOI generator

tasks.title: Audit log for external effects
tasks.body:
- **In** every send / submission / file written outside `state/`
- **Do** append an immutable line: timestamp, target, channel, artifact hash, verdict, evidence path
- **Out** `state/audit.log` (append-only)
- **Test** `audit.log` line count equals sum of `sends + submissions` tables for any given day

tasks.title: Dead-letter queue with classified retry
tasks.body:
- **In** failed task
- **Do** classify failure as `transient | blocked | fatal`; retry transient up to 3 with backoff; escalate the rest
- **Out** `state/dlq/` + retry schedule
- **Test** simulate 403 → classified `blocked`, retried twice, then escalated with the exact URL

tasks.title: Kill switch
tasks.body:
- **In** a file flag or a single command
- **Do** halt all outbound within one cycle without losing state
- **Out** run marked `halted`, partially completed work committed
- **Test** set the flag mid-cycle → no sends after the flag timestamp

tasks.title: Daily cycle scheduler
tasks.body:
- **In** cron/systemd timer
- **Do** the 06:00 cycle: scan → spec → stage → send → inbox → digest
- **Out** `state/reports/cycle-<date>.md`
- **Test** two consecutive unattended cycles produce two distinct reports and no duplicate sends

tasks.title: Mailbox pool and send governor
tasks.body:
- **In** a reply-rate target and the measured pool
- **Do** compute sends/day from Little's Law (sends = target / reply rate), cap each mailbox, spread sends across the pool by domain, and refuse to exceed a per-mailbox daily ceiling even when the queue is full
- **Out** a per-cycle send plan naming mailbox, domain and count
- **Test** ask for 10 replies/day at a 15% reply rate and the governor returns 67 sends/day across the required mailboxes; ask for 500/day and it names the mailboxes needed instead of silently exceeding the cap

tasks.title: Source scan: marketplaces
tasks.body:
- **In** BizBuySell / BizQuest / Flippa / BizBen search URLs
- **Do** stealth-browser page loads, batch of 8–10 per source; treat short dumps as `refetch`, not `unavailable`
- **Out** `state/listings/*.txt` immutable dumps
- **Test** ≥90% of requested pages yield >800 chars; every short dump carries a `refetch` marker

tasks.title: Source scan: firm sites and off-market signals
tasks.body:
- **In** broker/CPA/lender firm directories
- **Do** crawl for named principals + contact channel (email vs form)
- **Out** prospects with role + channel
- **Test** every prospect row has `channel ∈ {email, form, phone}` and a source URL

tasks.title: Listing text → 7-field spec
tasks.body:
- **In** raw dump or LeadSpec JSON
- **Do** extract company, industry, revenue, EBITDA, geography, urgency, target size; stamp each
- **Out** `state/specs/<slug>.json`
- **Test** `spec_builder <dump> --write` exits 0; a dump missing EBITDA refuses with the exact field named

tasks.title: Vertical normalization
tasks.body:
- **In** marketing headline
- **Do** map to canonical vertical + NAICS sector + revenue floor (40 verticals)
- **Out** `vertical`, `sector`, `floor_usd` on the spec
- **Test** "Turnkey 35-Year HVAC Company with Stellar Reputation" → `HVAC`, not the headline

tasks.title: ICP filter and reject reasons
tasks.body:
- **In** spec
- **Do** apply vertical floor + size band + geography rule; reject outside ICP with a reason code
- **Out** `state/rejects/*.jsonl` (slug, code, detail)
- **Test** every reject has a code from a closed enum; no reject is silently dropped

tasks.title: Blocked-field unblock ask
tasks.body:
- **In** spec with missing money fields
- **Do** generate a one-question letter naming exactly what's missing ("EBITDA with owner add-backs")
- **Out** staged `.eml` per blocked target
- **Test** 25 EBITDA-hidden listings produce 25 asks, each naming EBITDA and no other field

tasks.title: QLA 10-factor score
tasks.body:
- **In** complete spec
- **Do** score: cash flow, leverage, moat, seller motivation, transferability, upside, risk, financing fit, market, fit
- **Out** score + factor breakdown + GO/NO-GO
- **Test** a $1.2M home-health deal scores 10/10 with every factor printed; missing inputs lower the score, never raise it

tasks.title: Cross-source dedupe
tasks.body:
- **In** specs from all sources
- **Do** match on normalized name + geography + revenue band + phone; merge, keep first-seen provenance
- **Out** one canonical deal per business
- **Test** same business listed by two brokers yields one deal with two `sources[]`

tasks.title: Target profile card  *(step 11)*
tasks.body:
- **In** spec + source dumps
- **Do** assemble: what it does, who buys it, why it's for sale, what the owner wants, what's missing
- **Out** `target_profile` artifact
- **Test** card cites a source line for every factual claim; unsourced claims are absent, not softened

tasks.title: Generality red-flag sweep  *(step 12)*
tasks.body:
- **In** target profile
- **Do** check: market trajectory, customer concentration, licensing, litigation, environmental, key-person
- **Out** `red_flags` artifact with severity
- **Test** each flag maps to an evidence line or is labeled `unverified hypothesis`

tasks.title: Lice-comb deep dive  *(step 13)*
tasks.body:
- **In** red flags
- **Do** targeted public-records and registry checks; FOIA-style free sources only
- **Out** `lice_comb` artifact
- **Test** every finding carries a URL + retrieval date; zero findings is reported as "checked, clean", not omitted

tasks.title: Local market intel pack
tasks.body:
- **In** vertical + geography
- **Do** competitor set, pricing, seasonality, labor availability, licensing authority
- **Out** market section of target profile
- **Test** competitor list ≥5 named firms with a source each, or an explicit "thin market" statement

tasks.title: Search letter  *(step 17)*
tasks.body:
- **In** spec
- **Do** render the buyer's inquiry letter: cash + seller financing, one business at a time, two questions
- **Out** staged approach per broker prospect
- **Test** rendered letter contains no invented numbers; revenue band comes from the spec

tasks.title: Kiss-frogs sweeper  *(step 18)*
tasks.body:
- **In** replies marked `no`
- **Do** re-ask the same intermediary for the next name; keep a referral chain per target
- **Out** referral graph
- **Test** a "no" reply produces a follow-up ask for a referral, never a repeat pitch

tasks.title: Chairman role spec  *(step 6)*
tasks.body:
- **In** vertical + deal size
- **Do** define the chairman profile: sector credibility, exit history, network, time, compensation shape
- **Out** `role_spec` artifact + search parameters
- **Test** walker emits step 06 and refuses to advance until confirmed

tasks.title: Chairman candidate sourcing
tasks.body:
- **In** role spec
- **Do** build candidate list from public sources: retired operators, ex-division presidents, board members of comparables
- **Out** ranked candidates with evidence of fit
- **Test** ≥10 candidates, each with a public source proving the role they held

tasks.title: Board roster design  *(step 7)*
tasks.body:
- **In** chairman + gaps analysis
- **Do** propose 3–5 seats with the gap each seat fills (finance, sector, legal, operations)
- **Out** `board_roster` artifact
- **Test** every seat names the specific gap it closes; no "advisor" seat without a deliverable

tasks.title: Big Four / large CPA targeting  *(step 8)*
tasks.body:
- **In** geography
- **Do** find firms with acquisition accounting + QoE capability at this deal size
- **Out** verified prospects, role `accountant`
- **Test** every prospect MX-validated; approach letter asks capability + who runs it, not price

tasks.title: Top-tier counsel targeting  *(step 9)*
tasks.body:
- **In** geography + deal structure
- **Do** find M&A counsel; map to email or form channel
- **Out** verified prospects, role `counsel`
- **Test** channel assigned per firm; form-only firms queued to the browser channel, not dropped

tasks.title: Lender and banker targeting  *(steps 21 · 22)*
tasks.body:
- **In** deal size + collateral profile
- **Do** find SBA/commercial lenders and acquisition financiers with local appetite
- **Out** verified prospects, role `lender`
- **Test** letter asks appetite and PG requirement in one line; no lender is contacted without a deal spec

tasks.title: Verification pass before any contact
tasks.body:
- **In** prospect
- **Do** MX check, domain plausibility, one-per-domain selection, confidence score
- **Out** `prospects.db` rows eligible for approach
- **Test** 0% of staged approaches have a dead domain; no firm receives two letters from the same role

tasks.title: Role-specific letter rendering
tasks.body:
- **In** prospect + spec + role
- **Do** render letter with role→QLA-step mapping: broker 17/18, accountant 8, counsel 9, lender 21/22, chairman 6, director 7
- **Out** `.eml` with subject, body, greeting rules
- **Test** generic inbox gets `Hello,`; a named contact gets `Hi <First>,`; no nav text is ever read as a person

tasks.title: Cadence and stop rules
tasks.body:
- **In** staged approach
- **Do** follow-up ladder day 3 / day 7 / day 14; stop on any reply; max 3 touches per domain per quarter
- **Out** scheduled touches
- **Test** a reply at day 3 cancels days 7 and 14; quarter cap enforced in the ledger

tasks.title: Industry expert panel  *(days 31–60)*
tasks.body:
- **In** vertical + chairman in place
- **Do** recruit 2–3 operators who have run companies in the vertical; the timeline puts them in the same 30-day window as counsel and the accountant, not later
- **Out** expert roster with the specific question each one answers
- **Test** every expert has run or sold a company in this vertical, with a public source

tasks.title: Financial institutions warmed before the first offer  *(days 61–90)*
tasks.body:
- **In** deal pipeline + court assembled
- **Do** open lines with banks, insurers and PE so they are "warmed up & ready 2 accept 1st deal" inside 90 days — before an LOI exists, not after
- **Out** warm list with contact, appetite stated, and the date each was approached
- **Test** no LOI is drafted for a deal with zero warmed lenders; each lender shows an approach date

tasks.title: Retainer / engagement tracker
tasks.body:
- **In** positive reply
- **Do** track engagement stage per advisor: contacted → interested → terms → retained; hold the artifact each stage emits
- **Out** court status board
- **Test** court board shows which of the four seats are filled, at all times, with dates

tasks.title: Mole candidate identification
tasks.body:
- **In** target + vertical
- **Do** list non-transactional insiders: loan officers, insurers, suppliers, competitors' ex-staff, licensing clerks
- **Out** candidate list with the specific thing each could know
- **Test** every candidate row states one question only they could answer

tasks.title: Mole approach (non-transactional)
tasks.body:
- **In** candidate + question
- **Do** send a short, no-ask-of-favor note that earns a reply; never mention acquisition
- **Out** staged approach
- **Test** letter contains no acquisition language and asks exactly one question

tasks.title: Mole question bank
tasks.body:
- **In** vertical
- **Do** maintain the 10 questions that reveal real market conditions (churn, pricing pressure, labor, seasonality)
- **Out** question bank per vertical
- **Test** each question is answerable by a non-owner insider; no question requires confidential data

tasks.title: Answer intake and attribution
tasks.body:
- **In** mole reply
- **Do** extract claims, attribute to source role + date, mark `unverified` until corroborated
- **Out** intelligence entries linked to the target
- **Test** a claim appearing in two independent mole replies flips to `corroborated`

tasks.title: Reciprocity ledger
tasks.body:
- **In** mole interactions
- **Do** record what was given and owed; surface the moment reciprocity is due
- **Out** reciprocity queue
- **Test** no mole is asked a second favor with an open debt

tasks.title: Email channel
tasks.body:
- **In** staged `.eml`
- **Do** SMTP send with app password; record verdict `sent | failed | no_recipient` with the exact reason
- **Out** ledger row + Message-ID
- **Test** missing credentials → `failed` with the env var named, never `sent`

tasks.title: Form channel
tasks.body:
- **In** firm contact page
- **Do** render page in headless Chromium, map identity onto labels, fill, screenshot, submit, verify confirmation text
- **Out** `form_submissions` row + proof screenshot
- **Test** 9/10 fields filled on a live Gravity Form; `submitted` recorded only with confirmation text

tasks.title: Marketplace message channel
tasks.body:
- **In** marketplace listing with a contact form
- **Do** stealth-session form fill (headless is 403 at these hosts); one message per listing, referencing the ad id
- **Out** submission record with screenshot
- **Test** message delivered to a live listing inquiry form; headless fallback never attempted twice

tasks.title: Template library by role
tasks.body:
- **In** role + spec
- **Do** maintain letters for broker, accountant, counsel, lender, chairman, director, seller, mole
- **Out** versioned templates with change history
- **Test** every role renders without a missing-field exception on a complete spec

tasks.title: Personalization without invention
tasks.body:
- **In** prospect + spec
- **Do** use only fields that exist in the spec; vertical/geo/article agreement handled (an HVAC, not a HVAC)
- **Out** rendered letter
- **Test** grep the rendered corpus for numbers not present in any spec → zero hits

tasks.title: Rate limits and reputation protection
tasks.body:
- **In** send queue
- **Do** cap per domain (1/quarter), per provider (50/day), jitter intervals; pause on any bounce spike
- **Out** throttle state
- **Test** force 60 sends → 50 go out, 10 deferred, no domain exceeds 1

tasks.title: Bounce and complaint handling
tasks.body:
- **In** DSN / spam complaint
- **Do** mark prospect dead, suppress domain, log cause; never retry a hard bounce
- **Out** suppression list
- **Test** hard bounce → domain suppressed across all roles in the same run

tasks.title: Opt-out respect
tasks.body:
- **In** "remove me"
- **Do** permanent suppression across deals and roles, honored before any future send
- **Out** global do-not-contact list
- **Test** an opt-out prospect cannot be staged by any role, any deal, ever

tasks.title: Inbox fetch and thread assembly
tasks.body:
- **In** IMAP mailbox
- **Do** pull new mail, assemble threads, ignore self-sent and auto-replies
- **Out** reply records
- **Test** an out-of-office reply produces no deal state change

tasks.title: Intent classification
tasks.body:
- **In** reply text
- **Do** classify: interested / question / not_interested / out_of_office / bounce / other
- **Out** intent + confidence
- **Test** fixtures for all six classes classify correctly; unclassifiable goes to `REVIEW`, never guessed

tasks.title: Reply-to-deal matching
tasks.body:
- **In** reply
- **Do** match on sender address, ad id in subject/body, geography + name
- **Out** deal link or `unattributed`
- **Test** unattributable mail never increments reply rate

tasks.title: Walker advance on qualified reply
tasks.body:
- **In** matched qualified reply
- **Do** advance the walker to the next artifact, draft it, queue the confirm
- **Out** next-step draft + task
- **Test** an "interested" fixture advances exactly one step and creates exactly one human task

tasks.title: NDA dispatch
tasks.body:
- **In** qualified seller/broker
- **Do** send NDA template, track signature state, re-ping after 3 days
- **Out** NDA record + signed copy location
- **Test** NDA status is never "signed" without a copy of the signed file

tasks.title: Document request checklist
tasks.body:
- **In** NDA signed
- **Do** request the canonical set: 3y P&L, tax returns, CIM, leases, contracts, org chart, add-back schedule
- **Out** document tracker per deal
- **Test** each requested doc has a status: requested / received / missing / refused

tasks.title: Qualification scorecard
tasks.body:
- **In** documents received
- **Do** score against the 10 factors with evidence links; recompute the GO/NO-GO
- **Out** updated score with deltas from listing-stage score
- **Test** a score can only rise with a new document, never with a re-read of the same one

tasks.title: Human escalation with a brief
tasks.body:
- **In** any step needing a body
- **Do** create one task: who to call/meet, why, the 3 things to ask, duration, prepared evidence
- **Out** `state/tasks/*.md` + calendar slot
- **Test** every task has a reason string and an attached artifact; no task says "follow up"

tasks.title: LOI draft  *(step 19)*
tasks.body:
- **In** qualified deal + score + docs
- **Do** generate LOI: price, structure, escrow, exclusivity, diligence window, contingencies
- **Out** LOI 2,200+ chars + PDF
- **Test** LOI refuses to render if any money field is `assumed`

tasks.title: 1.5x coverage test  *(step 25)*
tasks.body:
- **In** price + verified EBITDA/SDE
- **Do** test debt service coverage ≥1.5x; refuse structures that fail
- **Out** coverage artifact with the arithmetic shown
- **Test** an SDE-as-EBITDA substitution changes the verdict and is flagged as `inferred`

tasks.title: Seller note structuring  *(step 23)*
tasks.body:
- **In** price, coverage, seller motivation
- **Do** propose note: amount, rate, term, standby, offset rights
- **Out** seller-note term sheet
- **Test** terms satisfy the 1.5x test at the proposed price, or the proposal states the gap

tasks.title: Alternative structures  *(step 24)*
tasks.body:
- **In** failed or marginal coverage
- **Do** generate alternatives: earn-out, consulting tail, asset-only, lease-back, deferred equity
- **Out** ranked alternatives with trade-offs
- **Test** every alternative carries its own coverage math

tasks.title: Asset leverage plan  *(step 22)*
tasks.body:
- **In** balance sheet + collateral
- **Do** identify assets the target already owns that can fund the deal (real estate, equipment, receivables, contracts)
- **Out** leverage memo
- **Test** every leveraged asset names its lender-eligible value and source

tasks.title: Action plan  *(step 20)*
tasks.body:
- **In** LOI + diligence state
- **Do** sequence every remaining action with owner, date, dependency
- **Out** `action_plan` artifact
- **Test** no action lacks an owner or a date; dependencies form a DAG (no cycles)

tasks.title: Critical path  *(step 21)*
tasks.body:
- **In** action plan
- **Do** compute the longest dependency chain; surface float
- **Out** `critical_path` artifact + calendar
- **Test** delaying any critical-path item moves the projected close date by the same amount

tasks.title: Negotiation turf strategy  *(step 26)*
tasks.body:
- **In** counterparty profile
- **Do** plan venue, sequencing, concessions ladder, walk-away
- **Out** `turf_strategy` brief
- **Test** brief states the walk-away number and the concession order before any meeting

tasks.title: Contract review pack  *(steps 27–28)*
tasks.body:
- **In** draft APA/NDA/note
- **Do** generate the package + an issues list for counsel: reps, indemnity, escrow, non-compete, assignment
- **Out** counsel pack
- **Test** every generated contract renders; issues list references clause numbers, not vibes

tasks.title: Closing checklist  *(step 29–30)*
tasks.body:
- **In** executed documents
- **Do** funds flow, lien releases, insurance, licenses, transfer consents, employee notices
- **Out** closing binder index
- **Test** no closing item is marked done without a document reference

tasks.title: Closing plan
tasks.body:
- **In** closing checklist
- **Do** timeline, parties, wires, verification steps, same-day sequence
- **Out** closing plan
- **Test** every wire has a verified callback procedure recorded (fraud control)

tasks.title: 90-day transition plan
tasks.body:
- **In** seller capabilities, key staff
- **Do** who stays, what transfers, what the seller must teach, in what order
- **Out** transition plan with weekly milestones
- **Test** every critical process has a named successor and a documented handover date

tasks.title: Post-close integration
tasks.body:
- **In** transition plan
- **Do** systems, payroll, reporting, first 13-week cash flow
- **Out** integration tracker
- **Test** 13-week cash flow exists and reconciles to opening balance

tasks.title: Re-evaluate  *(step 32)*
tasks.body:
- **In** closed deal
- **Do** compare plan vs outcome on every scored factor; extract what to change in the next search
- **Out** re-evaluation memo feeding the scoring weights
- **Test** the memo changes at least one scoring weight or explicitly records "no change justified"

tasks.title: Outcome ledger
tasks.body:
- **In** every deal
- **Do** store stage reached, reason for death, elapsed days, touches used
- **Out** queryable outcome table
- **Test** every dead deal has a reason code from a closed enum

tasks.title: Win/loss pattern extraction
tasks.body:
- **In** outcome ledger
- **Do** find factors correlated with progression; require n≥8 before claiming a pattern
- **Out** pattern report with sample sizes
- **Test** no pattern is reported below the sample threshold

tasks.title: Template A/B by reply rate
tasks.body:
- **In** sends + replies
- **Do** measure per-template reply rate with attribution rules intact
- **Out** template leaderboard
- **Test** unattributed replies never enter the denominator

tasks.title: Vertical playbooks
tasks.body:
- **In** completed diligence
- **Do** accumulate per-vertical: typical add-backs, valuation multiples, red flags, lender appetite
- **Out** playbook per vertical
- **Test** each playbook claim cites ≥2 deals or is labeled hypothesis

tasks.title: Knowledge ingestion
tasks.body:
- **In** new methodology documents, transcripts, filings
- **Do** index into the corpus with a stable id and version
- **Out** searchable index
- **Test** a query on a newly ingested document returns it with its source path

tasks.title: Needs-you queue
tasks.body:
- **In** escalations
- **Do** one queue, sorted by deal value × urgency, each item with duration + brief
- **Out** daily queue
- **Test** zero items in the queue are things the bot could have done itself (audited weekly)

tasks.title: Calendar scheduling
tasks.body:
- **In** any step needing presence
- **Do** generate `.ics`, upload to Drive, offer to push to a calendar when scope allows
- **Out** calendar file + invite text
- **Test** every human task has a proposed slot; no task exists without a date

tasks.title: Call briefs for unavoidable calls
tasks.body:
- **In** target + question
- **Do** 5-line brief: who, why now, three questions, what a good answer sounds like, what to do with a bad one
- **Out** brief attached to task
- **Test** brief fits one screen and contains no field the bot could have filled itself

tasks.title: Daily digest
tasks.body:
- **In** cycle results
- **Do** what moved, what's blocked, what needs a body, what broke — with numbers
- **Out** digest email + `state/reports/cycle-<date>.md`
- **Test** digest totals equal ledger totals for the same period

tasks.title: Approval surface
tasks.body:
- **In** pending sends/submissions
- **Do** one screen listing exactly what will leave the building, with the artifact preview
- **Out** approve / edit / kill per item
- **Test** nothing external leaves without an approval event recorded, except channels the owner has pre-approved

tasks.title: Provenance dashboard
tasks.body:
- **In** all deal records
- **Do** show which fields are verified vs inferred vs assumed, per deal
- **Out** dashboard view
- **Test** any deal with an `assumed` money field is visibly flagged before the LOI stage
